item_reviews.comment: Matches T1 averages (81.9 vs 79.8) and S1 statistics; central in-distribution result.
All three platform splits favor Brackenridge-Tox (84.6/82.1, 79.3/77.0, 81.8/80.2); directly supported.
All four subtypes higher; identity gap 3.7 is largest (threat 2.5, insult 1.3, obscene 0.8). Correct.
Cobble-Board numbers are correct, but it was the development set, so describing it as an unseen platform outside training is misleading.
Supported: Cobble-Board used for early stopping, checkpoint and threshold selection, no test partition, and no test reported for cmp4.

missing_core_findings.description: No genuinely held-out unseen-platform test exists: the only out-of-pool evaluation (Cobble-Board) was tuned on, so the generalization question remains unanswered; the advantage is confirmed only on held-out splits of training platforms.
